description: Defines the ProgramTable class and related components for managing MPEG program data and observers within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages MPEG program tables, observers, and NIT PIDs within the broadcast namespace.

classes.name: ProgramTable::Observer
classes.description: Handles section updates for a specific program table, notifying registered callbacks.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes MPEG section data and updates internal state.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an observer callback for a specific keyId.

methods.name: Program
methods.description: Retrieves and compares program data for a given keyId and programId.

methods.name: NITPid
methods.description: Returns the NIT PID associated with a keyId.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Generates a composite key from keyId and programId.

methods.name: AddProgram
methods.description: Adds or updates a program entry in the internal map.
